# Bharat Bank — Net Banking

> Demo Indian net banking portal with realistic account, transfer, bills, cards, deposits, and loan workflows.

## Pages

- [Dashboard](/): Account summary, quick actions, recent transactions.
- [Accounts](/accounts): All linked accounts overview.
- [Fund Transfer](/fund-transfer): IMPS, NEFT, RTGS and within-bank transfers.
- [Beneficiary](/beneficiary): Add and manage beneficiaries.
- [Bills](/bills): Pay electricity, water, gas, broadband, mobile and more.
- [Cards](/cards): Manage debit cards, limits and controls.
- [Deposits](/deposits): Open and calculate fixed deposits.
- [Loans](/loans): Browse and apply for loan products.
- [Investments](/investments): Mutual funds, stocks, bonds, PPF/NPS.
- [Settings](/settings): Profile and preferences.
- [Support](/support): Help and customer service.
